mission.objective: Promote the HP_20260530_001 skill watchpoints into a research-only skill provenance policy with authored/vendor_supplied/learned/unknown classes and pinning, quarantine-until-promoted, and non-laundering review rules, registered under V3-ANCHOR-008.

envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no changes to the .agents/skills/ skill files
no required record fields or enforcement
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the policy doc, registry read-first paths, and README scope bullet
any wording implies skill execution, enforcement, promotion, or routing is approved

verification.summary: Advisory lint, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only policy with no new dependencies, code paths, or skill-file changes.
The policy restates existing observed watchpoints as review rules instead of inventing untested controls; quarantine is named as review discipline, not a technical control.
skills_relied_on template support is listed as a named follow-up rather than silently added, keeping this mission's template surface untouched.
Scope stayed inside the policy doc, one registry read-first addition, and one README scope bullet.
No skill execution, enforcement, or promotion scope was added.

friction_notes: The policy's evidence base is operator-relayed external video evidence plus vendor documentation; no local skill-encoded verification trial exists yet, so rules 2 and 3 are untested against real skill behavior.
Provenance class unknown defaulting to learned is conservative and may overweight quarantine for benign vendor skills with poor metadata.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Promoting harness-profile watchpoints into named policy is a cheap reusable pattern: observe in a profile first, generalize only after the observation is recorded.
Provenance classes plus a quarantine rule give the sponsor a vocabulary for refusing unreviewed capability without needing any enforcement machinery.
A local bounded trial of skill-encoded verification is the natural first evidence mission for this lane.
